description: This file is the main entry point for the 'Home' module/dashboard in the SuiteCRM system. It initializes user preferences, loads dashlets and modules, handles cache building, and prepares the Smarty template for rendering the personalized home page dashboard.

classes.name: MySugar
classes.description: A class that handles dashlet display permissions and processing logic specific to the user and module context.

methods.name: checkDashletDisplay
methods.description: Checks whether a dashlet should be displayed for the current user.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes the dashlet with given sorting options.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Returns the HTML content to display for the dashlet.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns the header HTML for the dashlet.

methods.name: getFooter
methods.description: Returns the footer HTML for the dashlet.

methods.name: displayScript
methods.description: Returns any JavaScript required for the dashlet.
